dimensions.note: Strict request handling excludes credentials, source, and raw evidence; retained output is bounded and sanitized.
Every model method emits structured entry and successful-completion logs without payloads or secrets.
Malformed policy, identity, authority, workspace, provider/model, evidence, timestamp, and replay conflicts fail before the corresponding durable transition; audit provenance is retained in results.
Synthetic tests cover lifecycle success, malformed configuration, injected staged-write failures, replay/idempotency, policy denial, and no-authority completion attempts.
Stable claims suppress duplicates; request/result staged writes resume after either write fails; identical completed replay emits no writes.
The extension has no provider SDK, HTTP client, or external API call.
No handles or network resources are opened; canonical /tmp workspace claims must exactly match the platform-returned path.
README and fixtures use synthetic identifiers and contain no private infrastructure details.
All argument and resource objects are strict, bounded schemas; provider lists, model patterns, workspace roots, and authority references are validated.
Lifecycle, invocation request, and result specs each declare explicit lifetime and garbage collection.
This is a bounded incident state machine, not a remote CRUD resource wrapper.
No external mutation occurs; strict policy, lifecycle, identity, and audit gates run before persistence.
Mechanical review confirmed lifecycle-, request-, and result-prefixed names are disjoint and all writes conform exactly to their target schema.
All retained lifecycle, request, and result state is retrieved through readResource.
Initial public package version; registry reports no previously published version.
